ns2:course.label: Counterpoint and Fugue
ns2:course.description: Study of contrapuntal writing, including fugue, with emphasis on the works of J.S. Bach. Includes analysis of contrapuntal writing. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: MUS 202 and MUS 208, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Voice or Instrumental Music or Music Composition or Music History or Open Studies or Music or Musicology or Jazz Performance major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign or Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
